Leading and volunteering with the IEEE Student Branch

I am a member of the SASI IEEE Student Branch at SASI Institute of Technology & Engineering, Tadepalligudem. I coordinate, host and volunteer at technical events: ideathons, hackathons and student programmes.

This page collects photos from the events I have worked on.

SITE Anveshana 24-Hour National Hackathon

Anchor (Host)

Anveshana is the tech and cultural fest of SASI Institute of Technology & Engineering. I anchored the 24-hour national hackathon held as part of the fest in February 2026.

IEEE Day 2025 Ideathon

Main Coordinator

SASI IEEE Student Branch, together with the IEEE Vizag Bay Section, held the 2025 IEEE Day celebrations on 31 October and 1 November 2025. I was the main coordinator of the ideathon.

SIH 2026 Internal Hackathon

Event Coordinator (Volunteer)

The internal round selects teams for the Smart India Hackathon. I volunteered as an event coordinator for SIH 2025 and again for SIH 2026, helping with participants, the hall and the schedule. These photos are from August 2026.
